gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Jabees sells the 7Seven for $59.99 on jabees.com today (ChatGPT said '$74–$80'), or that MOJAWA's own store sells a refurbished 32 GB Run Plus for the same $59.99, next to the new one at $99.99.
standout_why: I opened soundmavericks.com (a cited result in the third chat) and aquarium-guides.com. Neither shows a price for any product; both use 'Check Price' buttons or relative tiers. Neither mentions the Jabees 7Seven's price, the MOJAWA Run Plus's price, or refurbished units. I couldn't open WIRED (both pages), TechRadar (the page came back empty), Verywell Fit or the Independent, so I can't rule out a dated price there. ChatGPT's own answers, which are built from those pages, show the 7Seven at '$74–$80' in all three chats.
decides: It confirms MOJAWA Run Plus at $99.99 as the only new 32 GB, IP68 pick from a big brand that fits under $100 at the maker's store. Purra Swim ($169.99) and Shokz OpenSwim Pro ($229.95, or $169.95 refurbished) are over budget. It also changes the value pick: the 7Seven costs $40 less than the Run Plus, not $20–25 less. A refurbished Run Plus at $59.99 (32 GB, IP68) is a same-price alternative to the new 7Seven, from a product we already list. The Jabees 7Seven Air ($49.99, 8 GB) is the cheapest maker-store option with a stated storage size.
